title: TeamConnect
problem_statement: Modern teams need better ways to collaborate and communicate, especially with the rise of remote work. Teams are often spread across different locations and time zones, making coordination difficult. TeamConnect will provide a comprehensive collaboration platform that helps teams work together more effectively and stay connected regardless of where they are.
target_users: Remote teams who need to collaborate more effectively
Managers who want to keep their distributed teams aligned
Employees who want better communication tools for daily work
user_stories: As a team member, I want to message my colleagues easily so that we can communicate quickly throughout the day
As a manager, I want to see what my team is working on so that I can manage projects and people effectively
As a remote employee, I want video calling so that I can connect face-to-face with my team when needed
As a team member, I want to share files easily so that everyone has access to the documents they need
acceptance_criteria: Team members should be able to send messages and participate in group chats
Video calling should work reliably for team meetings of various sizes
File sharing should be easy and well organized
The platform should work on both desktop and mobile devices

success_metrics.metric: Daily active users on the platform
success_metrics.target: Growing daily active user base over time

success_metrics.metric: Messages sent per day across the platform
success_metrics.target: High message volume indicating active and regular use

success_metrics.metric: Team retention and continued platform use
success_metrics.target: Teams continue to use and rely on the platform long-term

risks_open_questions: Very strong competition from Slack, Microsoft Teams, and other well-established tools
Network effects make switching to a new platform very difficult for established teams
Reliability and uptime are absolutely critical for any communication tool
out_of_scope: Advanced project management features in the first version
Enterprise security compliance and audit features
Advanced analytics, reporting, and admin dashboards
